I am 74 years old now, and I have farmed this land in Quzhou for 54 years. My wife and I are the only ones at home — our children work in Shijiazhuang and only come back for harvest. We have 5 mu of land and a well for irrigation. I only went to primary school, but I know my fields better than any book.

I will plant 3.5 mu of winter wheat this year, same as always. My neighbor saves me lumai seed every autumn — it is reliable and does not cost much. In early October, I will rotary-till the ground and sow about 30 jin of seed per mu. At planting, I put down one bag of compound fertilizer per mu, and then topdress with urea at jointing in spring. That is about 14 kg of nitrogen, 6 kg of phosphorus, and 3 kg of potassium per mu. I irrigate three times — at planting, before winter if the rain is scarce, and at jointing when the wheat starts to shoot up. I spray three times: herbicide once after sowing, and insecticide and fungicide only if I see problems. I expect about 450 kg per mu if the frost does not damage it.

After harvest in early June, there is no time to rest. I plant summer maize immediately on the same 3.5 mu. Everyone here uses no-tillage now — there is only a week between wheat harvest and maize planting, and at my age I cannot turn the soil that fast anyway. I buy hybrid seed from the shop, denghai or nongda, about one package per mu. I spread compound fertilizer at planting, about 13 kg nitrogen, 4 kg phosphorus, 4 kg potassium per mu. I irrigate twice — once at planting and once when the ears are forming. I spray three times for weeds and insects. If the summer storms do not flatten it, I should get 500 kg per mu.

For cotton, I keep 1.5 mu. Cotton is hard work — my back aches for days after picking — but the price has been decent and I have grown it for 30 years. I rotary-till in mid-April and plant guoxinmian, about 3 jin per mu. I use compound fertilizer as base and topdress once with urea. That is about 12 kg nitrogen, 5 kg phosphorus, 5 kg potassium per mu. I irrigate twice, once at flowering. The bollworm is the big problem, so I spray about 8 times in total including herbicide at the start. I hope for 280 kg of seed cotton per mu.

I am old, so I do what I know works. I watch what my neighbors do — Old Li down the road has the same size farm and we talk at the well. I do not buy the most expensive inputs, but I do not skimp on fertilizer either. A bad year hurts more than saving a few yuan. My wife and I do most of the work ourselves. We hire help only for wheat harvest if our children cannot get leave from their factory jobs.
